name: Spring4Shell (CVE-2022-22965)
description: Spring Framework class loader manipulation leading to remote code execution.
rationale: Remote code execution in a framework used on the request path via manipulated class loader binding. NIST SI-10 requires input validation; SI-2 timely flaw remediation. PCI DSS 6.2.4 requires secure coding practices that prevent injection. Listed in CISA KEV.
